Policies and Initiatives.title: CM Saini meets top World Bank officials, discuss AI & digital governance
Policies and Initiatives.summary: CM Saini met with top World Bank officials to discuss the implementation of AI and digital governance. The meeting aimed to explore ways to leverage AI and digital technologies to improve governance and public services. Key discussions focused on harnessing AI for efficient and effective governance.

Major AI Developments.title: World Youth Skills Day: As AI reshapes jobs, Chandigarh’s skill institutes race to bridge training gap
Major AI Developments.summary: On World Youth Skills Day, Chandigarh's skill institutes are working to bridge the training gap as AI reshapes jobs. The institutes are adapting to the changing job market by providing relevant training to students. This effort aims to equip young people with the skills needed to thrive in an AI-driven workforce.

Major AI Developments.title: CBSE expands AI curriculum, but Centre rejects Chandigarh’s Rs 95L plan for govt schools
Major AI Developments.summary: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has expanded its artificial intelligence (AI) curriculum. Meanwhile, the Centre has rejected Chandigarh's proposal to implement an AI plan worth Rs 95 lakh in government schools. The rejected plan was intended to enhance AI education in government schools.

Major AI Developments.title: Pargat targets AAP over ‘AI videos’ against jathedars
Major AI Developments.summary: Pargat has accused the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) of creating AI videos targeting jathedars. The AI videos are allegedly being used to defame the jathedars, sparking controversy. Pargat's accusation suggests a deepening political rift between him and the AAP.

Major AI Developments.title: AAP accuses Cong of using AI-generated deepfake to target CM Mann
Major AI Developments.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has accused the Congress of using an AI-generated deepfake to target Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. The AAP alleges that the Congress created and disseminated a manipulated video to defame the CM. This incident highlights the growing concern of deepfakes being used for political sabotage.

Major AI Developments.title: City plans hub for AI innovation, governance
Major AI Developments.summary: The city of Chandigarh is planning to establish a hub for AI innovation and governance at the Chandigarh IT Park. This facility aims to promote artificial intelligence development and regulation in the region. The hub will serve as a central location for AI-related activities, fostering growth and innovation in the field.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjabi University, PGIMER develop AI tool for rare skin disease diagnosis
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjabi University and PGIMER have developed an AI tool for diagnosing rare skin diseases. The tool utilizes artificial intelligence to aid in the diagnosis of these conditions. This collaborative effort aims to improve diagnosis accuracy for rare skin diseases.

Major AI Developments.title: PGI combines AI and ultrasound for early gallbladder cancer detection
Major AI Developments.summary: The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGI) is utilizing a combination of AI and ultrasound technology to detect gallbladder cancer at an early stage. This innovative approach aims to improve diagnosis and treatment outcomes for patients. The PGI's method has shown promise in identifying gallbladder cancer more accurately and efficiently.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-Ropar to deploy 100 AI weather stations across Punjab
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT-Ropar is set to deploy 100 AI-powered weather stations across Punjab. The initiative aims to provide accurate and real-time weather forecasts, leveraging artificial intelligence technology. The deployment of these weather stations will enhance weather monitoring and prediction capabilities in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: AI video linked to Golden Temple triggers row, SGPC orders probe
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-generated video linked to the Golden Temple has sparked controversy, prompting the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) to order an investigation. The video's content has not been specified, but it has triggered a row, leading to the SGPC's probe. The SGPC is looking into the matter to determine the circumstances surrounding the creation and dissemination of the video.

Major AI Developments.title: Punjab to integrate AI across depts; Mohali to be AI hub
Major AI Developments.summary: Punjab plans to integrate artificial intelligence across its departments to enhance efficiency. The city of Mohali is set to be developed as a hub for AI, driving innovation and growth in the region. This initiative aims to leverage AI technology to improve governance and public services in Punjab.

Major AI Developments.title: HC notice to Centre, others on plea for regulation of AI-generated content
Major AI Developments.summary: The High Court has issued a notice to the Centre and other parties regarding a plea for regulation of AI-generated content. The notice is in response to a petition seeking guidelines to control and monitor AI-generated content. The court's decision is pending, with the Centre and other parties required to respond to the plea.

Major AI Developments.title: BFUHS joins Consortium of Innovative Health Universities at India AI Impact Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS) has joined the Consortium of Innovative Health Universities at the India AI Impact Summit. This collaboration aims to leverage artificial intelligence in the healthcare sector, although specific details of the partnership are not provided. The summit facilitated the union, promoting innovation and AI adoption in health universities.

Major AI Developments.title: SGPC to meet AI firms to curb misleading content
Major AI Developments.summary: The Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) plans to meet with AI firms to address the issue of misleading content. The goal is to curb the spread of false information, particularly related to the Sikh community. The SGPC aims to collaborate with AI companies to find a solution to this problem.

Major AI Developments.title: Objectionable AI video of Golden Temple spark outrage
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-generated video featuring the Golden Temple in an objectionable manner has sparked widespread outrage. The video's content has not been specified, but it has drawn strong reactions from the public. The incident highlights growing concerns over the misuse of AI technology to create offensive content.

AI Start-Up News.title: Doodhvale Farms raises $1 Mn from Atomic Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Doodhvale Farms, a direct-to-consumer dairy brand, has raised $1 million in a follow-on funding round from Atomic Capital Fund I. This investment follows a $3 million Series A funding round in November 2024, co-led by Atomic Capital and Singularity Early Opportunities Fund. The new capital will be used for market expansion and increasing distribution in existing markets.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rajpura lineman’s daughter uses AI to secure 51st rank in UPSC exam
AI Start-Up News.summary: A lineman's daughter from Rajpura used AI to aid her studies and achieved the 51st rank in the UPSC exam. This notable achievement highlights the potential of AI in enhancing learning outcomes. The daughter's success is an inspiring example of how technology can help bridge the gap and facilitate academic excellence.
